Retail Construction Project Manager (Client Side)

Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Retail Construction

Industry: Designer Toys & Collectibles

Reporting to: Head of Retail Construction

About POP MART

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions and, through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world's first immersive intellectual property themed park in the art toy industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of art toy expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally.

In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high-potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.

For more information, please visit www.popmart.com and our LinkedIn Career page.

What to Expect

POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:

Play a key role in the continued expansion of POP MART's retail footprint across Europe.

Work on exciting retail construction and fit out projects that bring POP MART's distinctive IPs and customer experiences to life.

Collaborate with passionate teams across different countries, connected by a shared love for designer toys, creativity and innovative retail experiences.

Work closely with international HQ teams, designers, consultants, contractors, landlords and specialist suppliers across multiple markets.

Gain exposure to a broad range of construction, design, project management, commercial and operational activities within a rapidly expanding international retail business.

Help shape the physical customer experience of one of the world's fastest-growing designer toy and entertainment brands

Benefits

POP MART offers our employees:

Monthly appreciation gifts featuring our latest POP MART designs.

A structured bonus scheme linked to both company and individual performance.

25 days of annual leave, in addition to bank holidays.

4x life insurance, together with group medical and travel insurance.

A confidential Employee Assistance Programme, alongside access to a discount platform for selected online retailers.

Training and development programmes, together with regular team events that encourage learning, collaboration and celebration.

The Opportunity

Lead the end-to-end delivery of POP MART retail construction and fit out projects across Europe, from initial feasibility and design development through tender, construction, commissioning, handover and store opening.

Act as the client-side project lead, taking ownership of project delivery and coordinating internal stakeholders, international HQ teams, designers, consultants, contractors, suppliers and landlords.

Manage multiple projects in parallel within fast-moving retail opening programmes, ensuring agreed opening dates, budgets, quality standards and design requirements are achieved.

Provide strong technical and commercial oversight across the project lifecycle, identifying risks and resolving issues before they impact programme, cost or quality.

Play a key role in delivering high-quality retail environments that reflect POP MART's global brand standards and provide distinctive customer experiences across European markets.

Work across a diverse range of projects and stakeholders, gaining broad exposure to retail construction, fit out, design, procurement, commercial management and international project delivery.

The Role and Candidate

This is a hands-on client-side Retail Construction Project Manager role within POP MART's growing European retail construction team.

Working closely with the Head of Retail Construction, European business teams and international HQ, you will take responsibility for the successful delivery of retail construction and fit out projects across Europe. You will act as the central project owner, coordinating designers, consultants, contractors, suppliers, landlords and internal stakeholders from initial feasibility through to store opening.

The role requires a strong combination of technical construction knowledge, project management capability, commercial judgement and stakeholder management skills. You will be expected to understand the detail of a project while maintaining oversight of programme, budget, procurement, risk and overall delivery.

You should be comfortable reviewing architectural and technical drawings, coordinating MEP and specialist packages, challenging design solutions, monitoring construction quality and resolving site issues. At the same time, you will need to manage budgets, procurement, variations, project risks and contractor performance effectively.

The ideal candidate will have experience delivering retail construction or fit out projects from a client-side perspective, ideally within London, the UK and/or international markets. Experience within high-profile, premium, luxury or customer-facing retail environments would be particularly valuable.

You will thrive in this role if you are proactive, commercially aware, technically confident and highly organised, with the ability to take ownership of projects and drive multiple stakeholders towards a common deadline. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving international environment, making decisions under pressure and communicating effectively across different cultures, markets and time zones.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Programme Management

Manage retail construction and fit out projects from feasibility, concept and design development through tender, construction, commissioning, handover and store opening.

Establish and manage project programmes, key milestones, procurement schedules and delivery priorities.

Identify critical path activities and potential programme delays at an early stage and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

Act as the primary client-side project owner, coordinating all parties and driving actions through to completion.

Monitor project progress against agreed programmes and opening dates.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously across different European markets while maintaining clear priorities and delivery standards.

Design & Technical Coordination

Manage the development and coordination of architectural, interior, MEP, structural and specialist design packages.

Ensure designs remain aligned with approved design intent, POP MART standards and operational requirements.

Review drawings, specifications, samples, mock-ups and technical submissions.

Challenge design or technical solutions where buildability, quality, maintenance or operational requirements are not adequately addressed.

Coordinate interfaces between construction works, MEP services, bespoke joinery, furniture, lighting, AV, security and other specialist systems.

Manage design changes and assess their programme, cost, technical and operational impact.

Work with designers and consultants to resolve technical and coordination issues efficiently.

Construction, Quality & Site Management

Represent POP MART throughout the construction and fit out phase.

Carry out regular site inspections to monitor progress, workmanship and compliance with approved drawings and specifications.

Work with contractors, consultants and suppliers to resolve technical and site issues promptly.

Challenge works that do not meet required quality, installation tolerances or workmanship standards.

Monitor contractor performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

Manage snagging, testing, commissioning, defects and project close-out.

Ensure stores are complete, operational and ready for final acceptance and opening.

Cost, Procurement & Commercial Control

Establish and manage project budgets, committed costs and forecasts.

Work closely with internal stakeholders and cost consultants to maintain appropriate financial control.

Support tendering, contractor and supplier selection, commercial negotiations and procurement activities.

Manage the procurement of long-lead and specialist items.

Review quotations, variations and change requests.

Ensure commercial and programme implications are understood and documented before changes are implemented.

Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for project variations and additional expenditure.

Monitor project expenditure and identify potential cost pressures at an early stage.

Risk, Compliance & Project Governance

Identify and manage programme, cost, quality, technical and delivery risks.

Maintain clear mitigation actions and escalate material concerns with practical recommendations.

Ensure projects comply with relevant UK or local market construction requirements, landlord requirements, Building Regulations, CDM obligations and applicable health and safety standards.

Work with relevant consultants and stakeholders to ensure statutory and regulatory requirements are addressed.

Maintain appropriate project documentation, reporting and governance throughout the project lifecycle.

Provide clear and concise project updates to senior stakeholders, highlighting progress, key risks, decisions and required actions.

Stakeholder & Cross-Border Coordination

Coordinate closely with POP MART Europe teams, international HQ, consultants, contractors, landlords and vendors across multiple countries.

Maintain clear communication between European and international stakeholders to support timely project decisions.

Proactively follow up on design approvals, technical information, procurement decisions and overseas vendor deliverables.

Ensure overseas supplier and vendor deliverables remain aligned with project programmes and specifications.

Manage landlord, shopping centre, site access, logistics and operational requirements.

Work effectively across different cultures, working practices and time zones when required

Required Qualifications

Approximately 5–10 years or more of relevant experience in project management, construction or retail fit out, with proven experience acting in a client-side Project Manager capacity.

Strong track record delivering high-quality retail construction or fit out projects in London and/or international markets.

Experience delivering projects within complex, high-profile or operational retail environments.

Strong technical understanding of construction, fit out, bespoke joinery, furniture, MEP coordination and construction detailing.

Ability to critically review architectural, interior and technical drawings.

Good understanding of UK construction practices, Building Regulations, CDM requirements and health and safety obligations.

Ability to apply equivalent local requirements when delivering projects across European markets.

Strong project management capability across programme, budget, procurement, tendering, variations, risk management and contractor performance.

Strong understanding of construction quality, installation tolerances, workmanship standards, testing, commissioning, snagging and handover requirements.

Proven ability to manage multiple consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers while maintaining clear accountability and delivery standards.

Strong commercial judgement, organisational and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to work independently, make decisions and resolve issues effectively under demanding project timelines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively with European and international stakeholders.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Willingness and ability to travel within the UK and Europe as required.

Desirable but Not Essential

Degree or equivalent qualification in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Project Management or a related discipline.

Professional accreditation such as RICS, CIOB, APM or an equivalent recognised qualification.

Experience delivering projects within luxury fashion, jewellery, beauty, department stores, premium retail or other high-quality customer-facing environments.

Experience delivering projects within listed buildings, existing buildings, shopping centres or operational retail environments.

Experience managing international retail rollouts or multiple projects across different European markets.

Experience working with international design teams, overseas suppliers or global retail standards.

Experience coordinating specialist retail systems including lighting, AV, security, digital installations and bespoke customer-facing elements.

Experience working within fast-paced, high-growth retail or consumer-facing businesses.

Additional European language skills, such as French, Italian, German or Spanish, would be an advantage.

Experience or interest in the designer toy, retail, e-commerce or entertainment industries.

Apply

If you are an experienced construction or retail fit out professional who is excited to lead high-quality retail projects across Europe and play a key role in POP MART's continued expansion, we'd love to hear from you.

If you have strong client-side project management experience, excellent technical and commercial judgement, and the drive to deliver complex projects in a fast-moving international environment, this could be an exciting opportunity to join POP MART's growing European team.

*POP MART is committed to equal pay initiatives and will not ask candidates for their current or past salary.

*As an Equal Opportunity Employer, POP MART does not discriminate against applicants or employees

because of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, citizenship,

imarital or domestic/civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or because of

any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Procurement Coordinator

Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Visual Merchandising, Europe

Industry: Designer Toys & Collectibles

Reporting to: Head of Visual Merchandising Europe

About POP MART

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions and, through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world's first immersive intellectual property themed park in the art toy industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of art toy expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally.

In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high-potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.

For more information, please visit www.popmart.com and our LinkedIn Career page.

What to Expect

POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:

Support a fast-growing European business that combines retail, e-commerce, IP, marketing and creative storytelling.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams across multiple European markets.

Gain hands-on experience supporting the procurement and delivery of creative materials that bring POP MART campaigns, stores and customer experiences to life.

Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders across different countries and functions within an international business.

Contribute to campaigns, store openings, seasonal activations and other key commercial initiatives.

Develop your procurement, coordination and commercial operations skills in a dynamic and rapidly expanding environment.

Benefits

POP MART offers our employees:

Monthly appreciation gifts featuring our latest POP MART designs.

A structured bonus scheme linked to both company and individual performance.

25 days of annual leave, in addition to bank holidays.

4x life insurance, together with group medical and travel insurance.

A confidential Employee Assistance Programme, alongside access to a discount platform for selected online retailers.

Training and development programmes, together with regular team events that encourage learning, collaboration and celebration.

The Opportunity

Support the procurement and delivery of visual merchandising materials, POS materials, campaign materials, VM props and gifts with purchase (GWP) across POP MART Europe.

Play a key coordination role in ensuring purchasing requirements are processed accurately and delivered in line with campaign launches, store openings and commercial priorities.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams to understand purchasing requirements and coordinate orders across different European markets.

Manage purchase orders from initial request through to delivery, maintaining accurate records and proactively following up on outstanding actions.

Build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders to help ensure materials are delivered on time and to the required specifications.

Join a growing European team and contribute to improving procurement processes and ways of working as POP MART continues to expand.

The Role and Candidate

This is a hands-on coordination role within the Visual Merchandising, Europe team, supporting the procurement and delivery of materials required for POP MART's retail, marketing and visual merchandising activities.

Working closely with the Head of Visual Merchandising Europe and teams across Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising, you will be responsible for coordinating purchase orders for VM props, POS materials, campaign materials, gifts with purchase and other related items across European markets.

The role requires strong organisation and attention to detail, as you will manage multiple purchase orders, suppliers, delivery requirements and deadlines simultaneously. You will be responsible for ensuring orders are raised accurately, tracked effectively and delivered in line with campaign launches, store openings and other commercial priorities.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in purchasing, procurement, buying administration, merchandising operations or a similar coordination role, ideally within retail, consumer products, FMCG or another fast-paced commercial environment.

You will thrive in this role if you are highly organised, proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You should enjoy working collaboratively with different teams, be confident following up on outstanding actions and be able to identify and escalate potential issues before they affect delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their procurement and commercial operations experience within a growing international retail business.

Responsibilities

Purchase Order & Procurement Coordination

Manage purchase orders for VM props, POS materials, campaign materials, gifts with purchase and other related items across POP MART Europe.

Coordinate purchasing requirements with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams.

Ensure orders are raised accurately with the correct quantities, specifications, delivery locations and required dates.

Review purchasing requests to ensure all required information is complete before orders are placed.

Maintain clear visibility of purchase order status, outstanding actions and expected delivery dates.

Support the procurement process from initial request through to final delivery.

Supplier & Stakeholder Coordination

Liaise with suppliers to confirm orders, specifications, quantities, delivery requirements and timelines.

Follow up proactively with suppliers on outstanding orders, delivery updates and potential delays.

Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand changing requirements and communicate updates effectively.

Support coordination across different European markets and business functions.

Build positive and effective working relationships with suppliers and internal teams.

Campaign, Store Opening & Commercial Support

Coordinate purchasing requirements in line with campaign launches, store openings and other key commercial activities.

Ensure materials are ordered and delivered within agreed timelines.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising and Marketing teams to support seasonal campaigns, activations and promotional activities.

Coordinate gifts with purchase (GWP) requirements across different European markets.

Support the delivery of materials required for new store openings and other retail initiatives.

Proactively identify potential delivery risks and escalate issues where required.

Order Tracking & Documentation

Track orders from placement through to delivery and proactively follow up on delays, changes or outstanding actions.

Maintain accurate purchasing trackers, order records and supporting documentation.

Ensure key purchasing information is kept up to date and readily accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Monitor order quantities, delivery dates and specifications to help prevent discrepancies.

Provide regular updates on purchasing status and outstanding orders where required

Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

Support the resolution of delivery, quantity, invoice and other purchasing discrepancies.

Liaise with suppliers and relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues promptly.

Escalate material purchasing or delivery issues when appropriate.

Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, tracking and ways of working.

Support the development of more efficient procurement processes as POP MART's European business continues to grow.

Required Qualifications

2–3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, merchandising operations, buying administration or a similar coordination role.

Experience raising and managing purchase orders, preferably within retail, consumer products, FMCG or another fast-paced commercial environment.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail when handling order information, quantities, specifications and documentation.

Strong communication and coordination skills, with confidence working across different teams and European markets.

Proactive approach to following up actions, identifying potential delays and escalating issues when required.

Good Excel and general systems capability.

Strong administrative and record-keeping skills.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change according to campaign, launch and business needs.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable but Not Essential

Experience working within visual merchandising, retail, marketing, buying, merchandising or store operations.

Experience procuring POS materials, promotional materials, retail fixtures, props, gifts with purchase or similar creative/commercial items.

Experience supporting retail campaigns, seasonal activations or new store openings.

Experience working with purchasing, ERP, finance or procurement systems.

Experience working with suppliers across multiple countries or international markets.

Experience coordinating purchasing activities across different European markets.

Stronger-than-basic Excel skills, including experience with spreadsheets, trackers and data management.

Experience working in a fast-growing international company.

European language skills, such as French, Italian, German or Spanish, would be an advantage.

Experience or interest in the designer toy, retail, e-commerce, marketing or entertainment industries.

Apply

If you are an organised and proactive procurement professional who enjoys coordinating multiple stakeholders, managing purchase orders and supporting exciting retail and marketing activities, we'd love to hear from you.

If you have strong attention to detail, excellent coordination skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving international environment, this could be an exciting opportunity to join POP MART's growing European Visual Merchandising team.

Settore: Designer toys e pezzi da collezione

Sede: Milano Centro

Tipo di contratto: Full-time / Part-time - tempo determinato 6 mesi

Chi è POP MART

Fondata nel 2010, POP MART è un’azienda leader nel settore dell’intrattenimento e un punto di riferimento globale nella cultura dei designer toys. Attraverso lo sviluppo di artisti internazionali, la gestione di IP (proprietà intellettuali) e la promozione della cultura dei designer toys, abbiamo costruito una piattaforma integrata che copre l’intera filiera del settore.

Oltre ai nostri IP originali e iconici come Molly, Hirono, Skullpanda e LABUBU, POP MART collabora con importanti brand del mondo dei giocattoli e del lifestyle, tra cui Disney, Universal Studios e Sanrio, per creare art toy da collezione ispirati ai loro personaggi più celebri.

Per maggiori informazioni, visita www.popmart.com e la nostra pagina LinkedIn Careers.

Cosa Aspettarsi

POP MART è una realtà di dimensioni contenute con un team giovane e multiculturale, dove potrai:

• Acquisire un’esperienza professionale completa, che copre l’intero ciclo di vita del retail

• Lavorare con persone provenienti da diversi paesi e culture, in un ambiente collaborativo

• Ricevere una formazione strutturata in ambito customer service, operazioni retail e product knowledge

• Partecipare attivamente alla crescita dell’azienda

Benefici

POP MART offre ai propri dipendenti:

• Selezione mensile di giocattoli POP MART come regalo aziendale di apprezzamento

• Sistema di bonus e commissioni strutturato, basato sulle performance di team e aziendali

• Eventi sociali regolari con il team

Il Ruolo

Cerchiamo Store Associate entusiasti e orientati al cliente da inserire nel nostro team di Milano!

Come Store Associate, avrai un ruolo chiave nel garantire un’esperienza eccezionale in negozio, supportando le operazioni quotidiane e rappresentando il brand POP MART con energia e positività.

Se ami i designer toys e ti piace lavorare in un ambiente retail dinamico, questa è l’opportunità perfetta per te.

Responsabilità principali

• Offrire un servizio clienti eccezionale, aiutando i clienti a scoprire e innamorarsi dei nostri prodotti

• Supportare il Leadership Team dello store nelle attività operative quotidiane

• Garantire che il negozio sia sempre pulito, ordinato e visivamente accattivante

• Supportare la gestione dei pagamenti seguendo le corrette procedure in cassa • Monitorare la disponibilità dei prodotti e supportare la gestione dello stock

• Partecipare agli inventari e prevenire perdite o danneggiamenti

• Contribuire ai lanci di nuovi prodotti e agli aggiornamenti di merchandising

• Rispettare tutte le politiche e procedure aziendali

• Collaborare con il team, sostenendo i colleghi e promuovendo un ambiente di lavoro positivo

• Essere disponibile a lavorare su turni flessibili, inclusi weekend e festivi

Requisiti richiesti

• Almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo retail o a contatto con il pubblico

• Conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese, con ottime capacità comunicative

• Atteggiamento proattivo e passione per il servizio clienti

• Capacità di supportare gli obiettivi di vendita e contribuire alle performance del team

• Attitudine al multitasking e al lavoro in ambienti dinamici

• Affidabilità, organizzazione e grande attenzione ai dettagli

• Buona gestione del tempo e capacità di stabilire le priorità in modo efficiente

Spirito di squadra, positività e capacità di motivare gli altri

Requisiti preferenziali (non obbligatori)

• Esperienza nel settore dei giocattoli o dei collezionabili

• Conoscenza di ulteriore lingua straniera e/o cinese

• Familiarità con software di gestione retail e sistemi POS

Orario: • Dal lunedì alla domenica • Disponibilità nei weekend e festivi

Position Summary

This accountant is responsible for supporting the company’s daily finance operations, including vendor payments, cash-flow management, internal fund transfers, expense reviews, tax administration, and regulatory reporting.

The position ensures that financial transactions are processed accurately and on time, supporting documents are complete, and all activities comply with the company’s policies, approval matrix, internal controls, and applicable Indonesian tax regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Processing

•
Review, verify, and process vendor payment in accordance with the applicable approval matrix.

•
Process payments to vendors accurately and within agreed payment terms.

•
Process inter-company payments and maintain complete supporting documentation.

•
Verify invoices, purchase orders, contracts, tax documents, and other payment-supporting documents.

•
Coordinate with internal departments and vendors to resolve incomplete documents, discrepancies, or payment-related issues.

•
Maintain accurate payment records and ensure all transactions are properly documented and filed.

•
Monitor payment schedules to prevent late payments, duplicate payments, and operational disruptions.

Petty Cash and Cash Advances

•
Review monthly petty-cash and cash-advance submissions from store staff.

•
Check the completeness, accuracy, business purpose, and approval of supporting documents.

•
Follow up on outstanding cash advances and incomplete expense settlements.

•
Prepare reconciliation summaries and escalate overdue or non-compliant submissions.

•
Ensure petty-cash and cash-advance activities comply with company policies.

Treasury and Cash-Flow Management

•
Prepare and maintain cash-flow allocations based on approved operational requirements.

•
Process and document internal fund transfers between company bank accounts or entities.

•
Prepare accurate weekly cash reports for management review.

•
Monitor bank balances, upcoming payments, and short-term funding requirements.

•
Support cash forecasting and highlight potential cash shortages or excess balances.

•
Perform bank and internal transfer reconciliations and promptly investigate discrepancies.

•
Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and controls over all treasury activities.

Tax Administration

•
Assist with the preparation, filing, and payment of tax related matters.

•
Compile all shipments completed during the current month.

•
Prepare manual VAT invoice listings for each applicable invoice.

•
Review supporting information for completeness and accuracy before uploading it into Coretax.

•
Upload VAT-related data into Coretax within the required reporting deadlines.

•
Maintain organized tax records and supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes.

•
Coordinate with relevant internal teams to resolve missing or incorrect shipment, invoice, or tax information.

Regulatory Reporting

•
Prepare the quarterly LKPM (Investment Activity Report) for PMIDD.

•
Collect and validate the financial, operational, investment, and employment information required for LKPM reporting.

•
Coordinate with relevant departments to obtain accurate supporting data.

•
Ensure LKPM submissions are completed accurately and within the regulatory deadline.

•
Maintain submission evidence and supporting documents for future reference or regulatory review.

Internal Controls and Audit Support

•
Ensure all transactions follow company policies, delegated authority limits, and internal control procedures.

•
Maintain complete and well-organized records for payments, cash transactions, tax filings, and regulatory reports.

•
Support internal and external audits by providing requested documents and explanations.

•
Identify control weaknesses, recurring documentation issues, and opportunities to improve finance processes.

•
Maintain the confidentiality of financial, banking, employee, and vendor information.

Key Requirements

•
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Business Administration, or a related field.

•
Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in finance operations, accounts payable, treasury, taxation, or a similar role.

•
Practical knowledge of Indonesian VAT administration and tax documentation.

•
Experience using Coretax or similar Indonesian tax-reporting systems.

•
Familiarity with LKPM reporting is strongly preferred.

•
Experience processing vendor payments, reviewing expense claims, and preparing cash-flow reports.

•
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

•
Experience using accounting, banking, or ERP systems is preferred.

•
Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Spécialiste Fiscal Senior (Senior Tax Accountant)

Secteur : Designer collectible pieces

Lieu : Paris, France

Type de contrat : Cadre / CDI

À propos de POP MART :

Fondée en 2010 et arrivée en France en 2023, POP MART est leader mondial de culture pop et de produits artistiques de collection. Notre entreprise est présente dans quatre domaines d'activité : le développement mondial des artistes ; l’incubation et exploitation de la propriété intellectuelle ; le commerce de détail et la promotion de la culture de produits artistiques de collection.

POP MART, dont le slogan et l'objectif sont "Partagez votre bonheur", travaille avec des designers de renommée internationale tels que Kenny Wong, Pucky, Kasing Lung et Xiong Miao. Nous collaborons également avec des sociétés aux renommées mondiales telles que Disney, Universal Studios et Sanrio afin de créer des produits de culture pop basés sur des personnages et figures iconiques qui plaisent aux fans du monde entier.

Aujourd'hui, POP MART est présent dans 30 pays et régions (Asie, Océanie, Amérique du Nord, Royaume-Uni et plus récemment en Europe), et a accumulé des millions de fans à travers le monde.

A ce jour, POP MART compte plus de 400 boutiques physiques et plus de 2000 Robot Shops (distributeurs automatiques de produits POP MART).

Pour plus d’informations, consultez www.popmart.com ou notre page carrière LinkedIn.

Ce qui vous attend

Chez POP MART, vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique, multiculturel et en pleine croissance, où vous pourrez :

• Contribuer au développement rapide d’une activité européenne qui allie retail, art et storytelling créatif

• Collaborer avec des équipes passionnées dans plusieurs pays, partageant toutes la même passion pour les jouets design et les expériences clients uniques

• Développer vos compétences à travers des projets concrets, un apprentissage collaboratif et des opportunités de proposer vos idées

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Comptable Fiscalité Indirecte ambitieux(se) pour rejoindre notre nouvelle équipe fiscale européenne.

Alors que notre activité connaît une croissance rapide dans 15 à 20 juridictions européennes, ce poste offre une opportunité unique de contribuer à la structuration et au développement de notre fonction de conformité en matière de fiscalité indirecte.

Basé(e) au sein de nos bureaux à Paris, vous serez responsable de la conformité en matière de TVA à l’échelle européenne, en veillant à la fiabilité des déclarations, à l’efficacité des processus et à la maîtrise des risques fiscaux.

Il s’agit d’un poste à forte visibilité, particulièrement adapté à un(e) professionnel(le) disposant de premières expériences en conformité fiscale et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement international en pleine croissance.

Vos principales responsabilités

Conformité fiscale & reporting

• Gérer la conformité TVA dans 15 à 20 juridictions européennes, en garantissant le dépôt dans les délais de l’ensemble des déclarations de TVA, des états récapitulatifs de TVA (VIES/ESL) et des déclarations Intrastat.

• Assurer le reporting TVA lié aux activités de e-commerce.

• Coordonner les travaux avec les cabinets fiscaux externes et les représentants fiscaux afin de garantir la qualité et le respect des délais.

• Préparer les déclarations pour validation par le Head of European Tax.

Contrôles, rapprochements & qualité des données

• Réaliser, en collaboration avec l’équipe comptable, les rapprochements mensuels entre les déclarations de TVA et les comptes du grand livre dans NetSuite, et analyser et résoudre les éventuels écarts.

• Contrôler les comptes de TVA locaux et les pratiques d’enregistrement des dépenses afin de garantir le traitement TVA approprié des opérations (déductibilité, autoliquidation, dépenses non déductibles, etc.).

• Maintenir et contrôler les codes fiscaux dans NetSuite et collaborer avec les équipes IT et Finance afin d’automatiser l’extraction des données et de réduire les interventions manuelles.

Business Partnering

• Être le premier point de contact des équipes Opérations et Finance pour les questions fiscales courantes : exigences en matière de facturation, documentation liée aux expéditions internationales, statut TVA des clients, etc.

• En collaboration avec le Head of European Tax, apporter votre expertise sur le traitement TVA des nouvelles initiatives et activités commerciales.

• Élaborer des supports simples et animer des sessions de formation à destination des équipes Finance locales afin de renforcer leur autonomie sur les sujets courants de conformité TVA.

Gestion des risques & amélioration continue

• Documenter les risques fiscaux identifiés ainsi que les positions retenues.

• Assurer une veille sur les évolutions législatives en matière de fiscalité indirecte à travers l’Europe.

• Collaborer avec le Head of European Tax afin d’identifier les opportunités d’automatisation des tâches récurrentes et de standardisation des processus entre les différentes juridictions, dans une logique d’amélioration continue de l’efficacité.

Profil recherché

•
Expérience : 3 à 4 ans d’expérience en fiscalité indirecte.

• Parcours : Une expérience combinant un passage en Big Four / cabinet de conseil (permettant de disposer de solides bases techniques) et une expérience en entreprise (avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux business) est recherchée.

• Secteur : Une expérience dans le retail, le e-commerce ou la distribution est fortement appréciée.

• Connaissance des juridictions : Expérience en matière de conformité fiscale dans au moins 2 pays européens, dont au moins l’un des pays suivants : Royaume-Uni, Allemagne, France, Italie ou Espagne.

• Expertise technique : Bonne maîtrise des principes de TVA au sein de l’Union européenne, notamment en matière d’autoliquidation, triangulation, OSS/IOSS et report de paiement de la TVA à l’importation.

• Outils : Maîtrise des systèmes ERP (une expérience de NetSuite est un réel atout) et d’Excel.

• Langues : Anglais courant obligatoire, ainsi que la maîtrise professionnelle d’au moins une autre langue européenne (espagnol, italien ou allemand idéalement).

Compétences recherchées

• Culture du risque : Capacité démontrée à identifier, documenter et faire remonter les risques fiscaux.

• Communication : Capacité à expliquer clairement et de manière concise les problématiques liées à la TVA à des interlocuteurs non spécialistes de la fiscalité (Finance, Opérations, Logistique).

• Autonomie : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome avec des interlocuteurs et équipes répartis dans plusieurs pays.

• État d’esprit : Envie de rejoindre une équipe récemment créée et de contribuer à la construction et à la structuration des processus internes, plutôt que d'intégrer une organisation déjà totalement établie.

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world’s first immersive intellectual property themed park in the art toy industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of art toy expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally. In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.

The Role and Candidate

The Flagship BOH Stock Assistant supports the back-of-house stock operation at our new flagship store, helping to keep the stockroom accurate, organised and running smoothly so the sales floor is always ready to sell. This is a hands-on role, working closely with the BOH Stock Manager and the sales floor team to receive, process and replenish stock efficiently across a large, multi-level retail space.

The position suits someone reliable, detail-focused and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. The Flagship BOH Stock Assistant plays an important part in making sure product moves smoothly from delivery through to the shop floor, supporting the wider team's ability to deliver a great customer experience.

Responsibilities

• Receive and process deliveries, checking stock against packing slips and purchase orders, and flagging any damages or shortages.

• Support stock accuracy by helping with cycle counts and physical stock checks.

• Carry out putaway and stockroom organisation, labelling and storing products correctly so items can be found and replenished quickly.

• Security-tag stock and handle products carefully to avoid damage or loss.

• Replenish the sales floor promptly, working closely with FOH colleagues to respond to stock requests.

• Help maintain a clean, organised and audit-ready stockroom, following company best practice.

• Support the processing of faulty stock and supplier returns.

• Follow health and safety procedures in BOH areas, including keeping escape routes and walkways clear and reporting any hazards.

• Be available to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, according to store needs.

Required Qualifications

• Some experience in a stockroom, warehouse, or back-of-house retail environment is helpful but not essential — full training is provided.

• Reliable, organised and detail-focused, with a hands-on approach to work.

• Proactive and team-oriented, comfortable working closely with both BOH and FOH colleagues.

• Fluent in professional English, with good verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, physically active role within a high-volume retail environment.

Desirable but Not Essential

• Knowledge of CEGID POS usage

• Experience in the toy or collectibles industry

• Multi-lingual language ability

• Coordinate office facilities, maintenance and vendor relationships

• Manage office assets, supplies and equipment

• Process HR and office-related invoices and maintain administrative records

With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.

Role Overview

Responsible for leading public relations activities across Europe and the UK, ensuring alignment with the Group’s global communications strategy. The role will focus on developing localized PR initiatives, building and maintaining strong media relationships, and protecting and enhancing the company’s brand reputation across the region.

Responsibilities

• Regional PR Strategy and Planning: Support the development and implementation of regional PR strategies and communications plans, ensuring alignment with the Group’s overall brand positioning and global communications priorities while addressing the specific needs of European and UK markets.

• Media Relations and Brand Communications: Build and maintain strong relationships with key media outlets and journalists across Europe and the UK. Lead media engagement, coordinate interviews, and manage the development and distribution of brand communications and content.

• Media Monitoring and Crisis Communications: Develop and maintain effective media monitoring and early-warning processes to identify emerging issues and reputational risks. Lead local responses to significant media and reputational challenges, working closely with the Group’s PR team to develop and implement appropriate communications strategies.

• Stakeholder and Resource Coordination: Work closely with local teams, external agencies, and other partners to coordinate resources and ensure the effective planning and delivery of PR initiatives.

• Global and Regional Collaboration: Maintain regular communication with the Group’s global PR team, providing updates on regional developments, media coverage, and market trends. Contribute to the development and execution of global communications strategies, ensuring consistency across markets while accounting for local considerations.

• Brand Reputation and Narrative Development: Strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and reputation across Europe and the UK. Develop and refine the brand narrative for local audiences, ensuring consistent and effective messaging across relevant communications channels.

Requirements

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related discipline.

• At least five years of professional experience in public relations, journalism, brand management, or a related field. Experience working across cultures or markets is an advantage.

• A strong understanding of the European and UK media landscapes, business cultures, and communications practices is essential. Candidates should demonstrate an understanding of the differences between European markets, particularly in relation to media environments, cultural nuances, and language requirements. Previous experience working in European or UK markets is highly desirable.

• Excellent written and spoken English and Chinese, with the ability to independently manage media relations, prepare communications materials, deliver presentations, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds. Proficiency in at least one of the following languages would be an advantage: French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Dutch.

• A strong understanding of the European and UK media landscapes and public opinion environments, with an established network of relevant media contacts and industry relationships being an advantage.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills, with the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across different time zones.

• Proficiency in at least one of the following languages would be an advantage: French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Dutch.
